review: Independent original-to-final ZIP and Mach-O review; does not import packaging validation code
limitations: This review establishes package integrity and static root-bound policy, not iPhone runtime access.
The Objective-C native lease, known-file read/replace/delete loop, and document picker were not executed on an iPhone in this review.
Package integrity and selector presence do not establish protected-file return/deletion, picker presentation timing, conflict atomicity, or reboot recovery.
Unsigned final IPA requires signing that preserves its required main bundle identifier.
